stories.title: Cat on the Mat
stories.story:
# The Cat and the Mat

The cat sat in the sun. 

Dan had fat paws and a big lap. He ran to the red mat.

Dan sat on it. The mat was soft and warm.

But then—a pan hit the tiles!

Dan ran fast. His back got big. Tip, tap, tip, tap. His paws hit the tiles.

"Dan?" Pam said. She picked up her pan.

No cat.

Pam sat and waited.

Tip, tap, tip, tap. Dan came back. He crept to the mat.

Dan sat on the warm mat. He was happy.

The sun moved. But Dan stayed on his warm, soft mat—the best spot in the house.

stories.title: The Big Pig
stories.story:
**Tim and the Hot Pig**

Hot, hot, hot.

Tim ran to the big pig. She sat and sat. The pig had no zip.

Tim got his pan. He got the hose. Water hit the dirt. 

The dirt got wet. Mud! Lots of mud!

The pig saw the mud. She got up. Step, step, step.

SPLASH!

The pig hit the mud. Mud went everywhere! 

The pig dug in the mud. She rolled and rolled. The mud was cool on her hot skin.

Tim grinned. The pig was happy.

stories.title: Fit It In
stories.story:
**Tidy Time**

The cat sits.
The bat sits.
The hat sits on the mat.

Pat, pat, pat—
hands tap the rug.
Pat, pat, pat—
toys in the tub.

Can in the pan,
man by the van,
Dan and his fan
spin and spin.

Soft socks, warm socks,
tick-tock clocks.
The jam jar gleams,
the ram toy sits.

Pat, pat, pat—
feet on cool wood.
Pat, pat, pat—
everything good.

The cat sits.
The mat sits.
The dim room
still.

Moonlight spills
through windowsill,
and I
sit
too.
